text: You see Mathia.
source_text: You see Mathia.

text: Hello, Initiate. So, you are the one who made it out of the Ancient Order alive.
source_text:
Hello, Initiate. So, you are the one who made it out
 of the Ancient Order alive.

text: Wha?
source_text: Wha?

text: And who are you?
source_text: And who are you?

text: Sorry, I thought you were someone else. Bye.
source_text: Sorry, I thought you were someone else. Bye.

text: The name is Mathia. I am officially Maxson's assistant, but I am also here to make sure no one messes with the old man.
source_text:
The name is Mathia. I am officially Maxson's assistant, but
 I am also here to make sure no one messes with the old man.

text: Old man? That sounds a bit disrespectful.
source_text: Old man? That sounds a bit disrespectful.

text: What do you do as Maxson's assistant?
source_text: What do you do as Maxson's assistant?

text: Good to meet you. Bye.
source_text: Good to meet you. Bye.

text: No, no, not at all. He's a good guy. (Jokingly) Besides, I wouldn't bad mouth him while he is standing next to me.
source_text:
No, no, not at all. He's a good guy. (Jokingly) Besides,
 I wouldn't bad mouth him while he is standing next to me.

text: So, what is it that you do for Maxson as his assistant.
source_text: So, what is it that you do for Maxson as his assistant.

text: Goodbye.
source_text: Goodbye.

text: I take care of all the paper work. He could not do paper work to save his life. Also, if he clears a Weapons Upgrade for one of the Brothers, I process the order.
source_text:
I take care of all the paper work. He could not do paper
 work to save his life. Also, if he clears a Weapons Upgrade for one
 of the Brothers, I process the order.

text: Ok, thanks for the information.
source_text: Ok, thanks for the information.

text: I can't believe an idiot like you is the one who made the Ancient Order run. Go figure.
source_text:
I can't believe an idiot like you is the one who made the
 Ancient Order run. Go figure.

text: Hello again Initiate. How can I help you?
source_text: Hello again Initiate. How can I help you?

text: Wha?
source_text: Wha?

text: I'm sorry, I forgot your name.
source_text: I'm sorry, I forgot your name.

text: Sorry, I thought you were someone else. Good day.
source_text: Sorry, I thought you were someone else. Good day.

text: Alright, let's go. (He grabs you by the arm)
source_text: Alright, let's go. (He grabs you by the arm)

text: Uh huh.
source_text: Uh huh.

text: Uh uh.
source_text: Uh uh.

text: Alright, Alright. I'm moving.
source_text: Alright, Alright. I'm moving.

text: Get the hell away from me. I'm not going anywhere.
source_text: Get the hell away from me. I'm not going anywhere.

text: Ok. Maxson has cleared a weapons upgrade for you. What would you like?
source_text:
Ok. Maxson has cleared a weapons upgrade for you. What would
 you like?

text: Wha?
source_text: Wha?

text: Sniper Rifle.
source_text: Sniper Rifle.

text: Rocket Launcher.
source_text: Rocket Launcher.

text: Laser Pistol.
source_text: Laser Pistol.

text: Power Fist.
source_text: Power Fist.

text: Ripper.
source_text: Ripper.

text: There you go. Glad you are on our side Initiate.
source_text: There you go. Glad you are on our side Initiate.

text: The Elders have called a meeting. They wish you to meet them in the conference room right away.
source_text:
The Elders have called a meeting. They wish you to meet them in the
 conference room right away.

text: Where is the conference room?
source_text: Where is the conference room?

text: Ok, thank you.
source_text: Ok, thank you.

text: It's on this floor. The northeast corner, right behind the assembly hall.
source_text: It's on this floor. The northeast corner, right behind the assembly hall.
